name: Oribatid mite (Zygoribatula)
description: An oribatid mite (Zygoribatula sp.) - the most abundant animal of the oases (100 collected) and the principal primary decomposer, grazing fungal-infected litter (an estimated 70% of its diet) and possibly helping control fungal pathogens of the grass. Species node matching the source's Zygoribatula sp. taxon.
